sql_templates.description: Fetch outcomes and prices for resolved signals.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  ssl.symbol, 
  ssl.signal, 
  ssl.hit_target, 
  ssl.hit_stop, 
  ssl.return_pct, 
  ss.stage, 
  ss.technical_score, 
  me.close 
FROM 
  signals.signal_log ssl 
JOIN 
  scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ssl.symbol = ss.symbol 
JOIN 
  market.equity_eod me ON ssl.symbol = me.symbol 
WHERE 
  ssl.date_resolved IS NOT NULL 
  AND me.trade_date BETWEEN ssl.date_issued AND ssl.date_resolved 
  AND ssl.date_issued >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' 
ORDER BY 
  ssl.date_resolved DESC 
LIMIT 50;
